Some sexy underwear, cute stuff and new fashion trends would look great on her.
There’s so many different shops in this district.
‘Buy here! Now!’ {{wi}} ‘Best deals here!’ {{wi}}’Minus 79% off! Only 13 minutes left!’
But there is a problem…
Wouldn’t it be weird for me to go to a shop and buy a bunch of women's panties and such? 
First few times I could play it off with ‘I’m buying a present for my sister haha’ or something like that, but after a while shop keepers would get suspicious... 
W-what if someone that knows me would see me doing it? {{wi}}My life would be over…
The worst thing would be that that because of sexual preference parity in politics, as a registered believer, conservatives would try to recruit me to their party… {{wi}}Many such cases...
Oh man… {{wi}}What am I supposed to do?
Should I just go back home and buy something on the net?
Yeah, that’s a good idea.
It is always better to check the fabrics and what not yourself and of course there is no delivery cost in a real shop, but I guess I have no choice…
Huh?
What is this sign about? It’s different from all these flashy ones.
‘Lady Annalie’s clothing shop. Dirt cheap. Wide variety. No questions asked.’
‘No questions asked’? {{wi}}That’s exactly what I’m looking for.{{wi}} Kinda suspicious, but I guess I can check it out.
